method: Supervised RGB settled-level ridge and residual MLP refit with consumed development views; retained localization, empty CNN and contextual motion behavioral cloning with IK; programmed stop and direct return with late-pour lip alignment.

recording_repair.scope: Recording clock validation, incomplete-attempt audit and development recovery only. Learned checkpoint, policy/vision/physics/motion files and reserved-test builder are unchanged.

recorded_window_probes.name: FN30_A_dev_05_retry1_r0
recorded_window_probes.scope: Recorded prediction window clears proposed threshold; future three-vote confirmation still requires native development.

full_stop_calibration.scope: Development-selected scalar calibration. Validation margin is empirical, not a physical guarantee. Old outcomes are retained. All eight layouts must run again before reserved evaluation.

initial_pour_calibration.scope: Development-selected initial brake at 82% projected CNN level, then at most thirteen pause/top-up cycles. Full-stop target, 60-second limit, physics, motion, learned weights and scoring are unchanged. Native r2 remains required; no previous outcome is relabeled.

selection_scope: Historical validation selects among fits meeting the declared consumed-development residual screen; development residuals are training error, not generalization evidence.

level_refit.scope: Candidate only. Refit changes the settled regressor and validation-derived full threshold; adds 8 mm late lip alignment. No active deployment, native success or reserved result claimed.

late_drip_alignment.scope: Programmed geometry adjustment combined with refit; dynamic validation pending.
